reviews.comment: Dr. Smotherman is a funny guy! His lectures can be engaging, especially when he's passionate about a topic. Sometimes he just reads off the slide notes though lol. He's always in his office, so ask him lots of questions. The exams are difficult, but not bad if you go to class. DO THE STUDY GUIDES! They will save you. Go to class - trust me!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 10/10 for Dr.Smotherman. He's funny & engaged in lectures, I loved the flow of them, the way he explains topics makes so much sense! He doesn't just reads slides; they're more pictures than words, attendance is needed to know everything on the tests, listen! You don't want to miss his brain breaks 100/10! I wouldn't stress abt this class, enjoy it!

Pay attention to what he emphasizes in the lecture, it will be on the exam. Reading the textbook (at least the stuff he includes on slides) is helpful. Use old exams to study for the final. He is helpful in office hours. Exams are relatively tough.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Smotherman explains challenging topics very clearly and is patient when you ask him questions. The exams are kinda difficult but predictable if he gives a study guide/review. Overall very kind, funny, and intelligent

A truly great professor. Hilarious and engaging, truly looked forward to attending lectures and was always available to help during office hours and really cared about you learning the material. Quizzes are pretty much completion grades. Exams are non cumulative and very doable. Textbook needed, attendance not mandatory, but highly recommended.

Dr. Smotherman truly enjoys teaching. His exams are easy if you attend lecture, which he makes pretty engaging. Although attendance isn't really necessary if you're willing to read the book. The class comprises 5 quizzes, 5 assignments, and 3 non-cumulative exams. The quizzes and assignments are easy and basically free points.
